source.name: LMArena (categories and other arenas)
source.description: Official LMArena leaderboard dataset (latest snapshot): text categories, image/video arenas, Image-to-WebDev and Agent Arena.
notes: Elo-unit scores = arena rating (Bradley-Terry, higher is better); bounds, rank, vote count in extra. Model names and organization exactly as in the dataset.
Text categories use the raw 'text' subset (same as the existing 'LMArena Text' rows), not text_style_control. All 28 non-overall text categories are included as separate benchmarks.
Image Edit uses the dataset's 'overall' category of image_edit; the site's 'single-image' view could not be checked (arena.ai answers 403 to automated access).
Agent: score is the Agent Arena aggregate (fraction); cost_per_task_usd is the published median (cost_per_task_p50); median output tokens per task in extra.
arena.ai pages were not opened (403 to automated access); URLs are given for reference only.
developer = the dataset's organisation code with a capital first letter, as in data/lmarena.json
